# FFmpeg configure arguments of FFmpegKit 9.0.2, one per line, in order (duplicates included).
# Recovered from the configuration string embedded in the 9.0.2 binaries (avutil_configuration());
# kingslay/FFmpegKit no longer publishes its build plugin. --prefix is added by build_slice.sh.
# @ARCH@  = aarch64 | x86_64          (as FFmpegKit: --arch=aarch64 / --arch=x86_64)
# @DEBUG@ = 1 for device slices, 0 for simulator slices (as FFmpegKit)

# 9.0.2 libraries, slice by slice, and fails on any difference other than --prefix.
